title: About Haozhou Xu
texts: Hi, I am a Machine Learning Engineer at Google Ads, working on model design and quality analysis. My research interests include Reinforcement Learning, Uncertainty Quantification, and Active Learning.

I received my M.S. in Computer Science from UC San Diego and my bachelor's degree from the University of Hong Kong. I worked with Profs. Yian Ma and Rose Yu on active learning, and previously collaborated with Profs. Eric Schuldenfrei, Hayden Kwok-Hay So, and Hengshuang Zhao at HKU.
I also enjoy photography. Welcome to explore my Photo Gallery.
